'''Personio''' is a European software company headquartered in [[Munich]], [[Germany]] that develops cloud-based [[human resource management]] software for small and medium-sized businesses operating internationally.<ref name="TC2017">{{Cite web |title=Personio, a HR startup in Munich, closes $12M Series A |url=https://techcrunch.com/2017/08/03/personio/ |website=TechCrunch |date=2017-08-03 |access-date=2026-04-08}}</ref><ref name="TC2022">{{Cite web |title=Personio nabs $200M at a $8.5B valuation as its HR for small businesses hits the big time |url=https://techcrunch.com/2022/06/21/personio-nabs-200m-at-a-8-5b-valuation-as-its-hr-for-small-businesses-hits-the-big-time/ |website=TechCrunch |date=2022-06-21 |access-date=2026-04-08}}</ref>

Its platform is delivered as a [[Human resources information systems|human resources information system]] (HRIS) within the broader category of human resource management software. The software is used for functions such as HR administration, [[recruitment]] and [[payroll]], including the management of [[human resource policies]] and compliance.<ref name="TC2022" />

The company was founded in 2015 by Hanno Renner, Ignaz Forstmeier, Roman Schumacher and Arseniy Vershinin.<ref name="Sifted2020">{{Cite web |title=Will German startup Personio become an HR tech unicorn? |url=https://sifted.eu/articles/personio-hr-tech |website=Sifted |date=2020-01-23 |access-date=2026-04-08}}</ref> By June 2024, Personio had around 12,000 customers across 70 countries and approximately 2,000 employees.<ref name="Sifted2024">{{Cite web |title=How Personio built an $8.5bn business — and plans to keep growing |url=https://sifted.eu/articles/personio-hr-tech-startup |website=Sifted |date=2024-06-03 |access-date=2026-04-08}}</ref>

In 2022, the company was valued at $8.5 billion following a funding round reported by [[TechCrunch]].<ref name="TC2022" />
== History ==
Personio was founded in Munich in 2015. In its early years, the company focused on HR software for small and medium-sized businesses, including tools for personnel administration and recruiting.<ref name="TC2017" />

In 2017, Personio raised $12 million in Series A funding led by Northzone.<ref name="TC2017" />

In 2020, the company raised $75 million in Series C funding at a reported valuation of about $500 million.<ref name="TC2020">{{Cite web |title=Personio, the German HR platform for SMEs, raises $75M Series C at a $500M valuation |url=https://techcrunch.com/2020/01/20/personio-the-german-hr-platform-for-smes-raises-75m-series-c/ |website=TechCrunch |date=2020-01-20 |access-date=2026-04-08}}</ref>

In 2021, Personio raised $125 million at a reported valuation of $1.7 billion, reaching unicorn status.<ref name="Forbes2021a">{{Cite web |title=Meet The German Under 30 Honoree Whose HR Platform Just Raised $125 Million |url=https://www.forbes.com/sites/igorbosilkovski/2021/01/18/meet-the-german-under-30-honoree-whose-hr-platform-just-raised-125-million-on-a-17-billion-valuation/ |website=Forbes |date=2021-01-18 |access-date=2026-04-08}}</ref>

Later in 2021, the company raised a further $270 million at a reported valuation of $6.3 billion.<ref name="Forbes2021b">{{Cite web |title=German Startup Personio's Valuation Soars To $6.3 Billion |url=https://www.forbes.com/sites/iainmartin/2021/10/11/german-startup-personios-valuation-soars-to-63-billion/ |website=Forbes |date=2021-10-11 |access-date=2026-04-08}}</ref>

In 2022, Personio raised another $200 million, valuing the company at $8.5 billion.<ref name="TC2022" />

The company has expanded internationally, including offices in Amsterdam, Barcelona, Dublin, London, Madrid and New York.<ref name="Sifted2023">{{Cite web |title=German HR tech Personio opens New York office, plans to double US workforce |url=https://sifted.eu/articles/personio-opens-new-york-office |website=Sifted |date=2023-09-13 |access-date=2026-04-08}}</ref>
== Platform ==

Personio provides a cloud-based HR software platform delivered as [[software as a service]] (SaaS). The platform functions as a human resources information system, supporting core HR processes such as employee data management, recruitment, time tracking and payroll.

It integrates multiple HR functions into a single system and automates administrative workflows associated with human resource management. The platform also includes reporting and analytics tools to support HR decision-making.
